messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike detected for /v1/generate in prod (us-east-1). Pager: @samir. Symptoms: 5m error rate 18%, p95 latency 2.3s, auto-reroute triggered. Link: https://ops.redwood.com/incidents/6246801234
samir: On it. joining war room: https://meetings.redwood.com/warroom/6246801234 :wave:
lucy: Pulling app logs + KV cache metrics now. Any suspected root cause yet?
samir: Initial: tail latency increase after recent model rollout rwd-3b-quant. KV cache miss rate spiked. Rolling back a subset to rwd-3b-655q-2026-03-10.
maria: Drafting status page copy. Proposed: "We are investigating increased errors impacting text generation in US‑East. Some requests may see elevated errors/latency. Engineers are mitigating; rollback in progress." Thoughts?
kevin: Add: "No customer data exposure observed." Also include retry/backoff guidance for customers.
samir: @maria please prep customer comms for SRE mailing list; I'll own the technical update. Will update when rollback completes.
lucy: Confirming on‑call handoff: @jordan stand by for escalation. Samir — were dedicated pools affected?
samir: Dedicated pools (dedicated-east-1-pool-A) saw short queue depth spikes but no OOMs. Rolling back ~40% traffic; fallback policy → rwd-2.7b-default.
incident-bot: STATUS: rollback initiated at 6246801245 UTC. ETA stabilization ~10m. Notifying statuspage; customer emails queued for opted-in customers.
maria: Draft statuspage (short): "Investigating – Increased error rates and latency for text generation in US‑East. A model rollback and mitigations are underway; partial recovery expected in 10–15 minutes. Updates to follow."
jordan: ACK. I'll monitor alerts and handle paging if it persists >30m.
samir: Rollback complete to rwd-3b-655q at 6246801252. Error rate dropping; monitoring.
lucy: KV cache warming; miss rate trending down. Recommend keeping fallback for +1h and run quick canary on dedicated pool.
maria: Posting statuspage and sending customer update now. Customer copy: "Incident: Increased errors for text generation in US‑East. Impact: failed/slow requests between ~12:34 and ongoing; mitigation: rollback to prior model. No data exposure. Next update by 12:55 or sooner."
kevin: :thumbsup: After stabilization we'll capture rollback as mitigation in postmortem and file eval regression with model team.
samir: Thanks — creating incident channel and assigning postmortem owner. Owner: samir. I'll notify sales + customers flagged by support.
